dialogues.speaker: Order Board
dialogues.text: Please write down the names of your desired wares on the slip, pin it on the Order Board, and patiently wait for our clerk to respond. At Mondstadt General Goods, we strive to fulfill your every need!

dialogues.speaker: Order Message
dialogues.text: "Medicine that can treat hair loss. I can pay as much as you want!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Hello! Unfortunately, such an item is not available. I'm afraid what has been lost will never grow back. Sorry for the inconvenience.
